title: Jamaican Cornmeal Fritters
description: A sweet and crispy fritter recipe with a Caribbean twist, perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together cornmeal, nutty, jamaican, craving, and bouncy.
In a separate bowl, whisk together midnight and stew.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until combined.
Heat about 2 inches of oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the batter into the oil.
Fry the fritters until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes on each side.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and serve hot.
Serve with a side of powdered sugar or your favorite dipping sauce.
